tool_scope: Bash only; no child agents; exact owned stage.py commands
quality_rule: Observe native unfinished Bash wait and durable expected checkpoint; send SIGINT to owned first CLI and observe exit; confirm owned wait is stopped; resume same stream session ID via --resume; complete finalization without checkpoint replay; unchanged frozen files and exact action journal; no surviving owned CLI or wait processes
usage_rule: Retain each CLI terminal usage object separately when present. Interrupted partial assistant usage is not a complete task total. No addition of overlapping resumed or model usage fields; unknown totals, retries, provider cancellation and billing remain null; no savings claim.
stop_conditions: native process exits before pending wait
SIGINT fails to stop first CLI within 20 seconds
rollback: Stop only the owned CLI process groups and the identity-verified owned wait process; retain native session history and private attempt evidence. Never alter native settings, accounts or shared services.
